polished marble with swirling patterns, reflecting the lights and dancers

three other dancers: to her left, a woman in a sleek black satin gown with a high slit and matching heels, her arms gracefully extended; behind her, a man in a classic black tuxedo with a white bow tie and matching trousers, hands on hips, looking forward with a composed expression; to her right, another woman in a similar black satin gown mirrors the pose of the dancer on the left, and beside her, a man in a tuxedo stands with hands on hips, looking toward the central dancer with a subtle smile
soft yet dramatic, with strong highlights on the sequins and satin, and deep shadows that enhance the luxurious textures
rich and saturated—deep blacks, golds, burgundies, and warm amber tones—with high contrast and a slightly vintage film grain to enhance the retro aesthetic
